name: Kamimura Azuma
source:
Azuma was born into a clan of vampire hunters that have hunted evil vampires since ancient times.
She is an excellent hunter and rumored to be the best in Japan, one of the leading country against the vampires. 
A keen six-sense and she is quick to detect any abnormalities.

She is usually a teacher at Hayato Gakuen, which is run by Kitae and trains technician.
Considered a delinquent teacher, but she loves her student and tend to sacrifice herself if they're in danger.
Her weapon is metal bat which is said to have sucked the blood of a thousand vampires, passed down from generations to generations in her family.
